reason: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:20-25, the migration reads the legacy embeddable_hosts setting, splits it on newlines, and interpolates each host directly into raw SQL via VALUES ('#{h}', ...) at line 25 without quoting or parameter binding.
